title: Spicy Satay with Kippers
description: A fusion of Thai and British flavors in this spicy, indulgent satay dish featuring kippers.

ingredients.name: Fish sauce
ingredients.notes: Optional, or substitute with soy sauce

instructions: 3. In a blender or food processor, combine Thai red curry paste, fish sauce (if using), brown sugar, lime juice, and chili flakes (if using). Blend until smooth.
4. In a large bowl, combine blended marinade, kipper pieces, and coconut milk. Mix well to coat.
5. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
6. Thread kipper pieces onto satay sticks, leaving a small space between each piece.
7. Brush satay sticks with peanut oil and grill for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
8. Serve immediately, garnished with chopped cilantro and additional peanut oil if desired.
9. Serve with your favorite Thai sides, such as steamed rice or vegetables.
10. Enjoy your spicy satay with kippers!
11. For a more authentic experience, serve with spicy peanut sauce or sambal oelek.
